earlier_scan.source_named: Only early contact wordlist material (Simpson 1996, Early language contact varieties in South Australia, ~20pp); no grammar or phonology plausibly covering stress located.

sources.citation: Amery, Rob (2016). Warraparna Kaurna! Reclaiming an Australian language. Adelaide: University of Adelaide Press. DOI 10.20851/kaurna.
sources.note: Nothing about stress in the pidgin. Mentions Pidgin Kaurna only as a briefly-existing jargon attested in Koeler's eight sentences, Williams' (1840) sentences ('more reminiscent of a kind of Pidgin Kaurna or interlanguage variety.. no evidence of any Kaurna case marking'), Wyatt's translation of Gawler's 1838 speech, and a Hack 1837 letter; refers to Simpson (1996) for the full analysis. (Its stress statements, pp. xiv and 137, concern Kaurna proper, not the pidgin.)
